notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null; no hardware was attached and no hardware or live ROS run is claimed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card says family ros / helper RosDriver, but the pinned clone has no command topic, service, action or controller node. README.md:5 calls the repository a 'Robot model description package ... providing URDF, MuJoCo (MJCF), and USD assets for simulation and visualization'; hand/body/launch/display.launch.py:19-45 starts only robot_state_publisher, joint_state_publisher_gui and rviz2; hand/body/package.xml:4-6 and hand/body/CMakeLists.txt:6-9 describe and install model assets. The concrete interface the repository ships is the MuJoCo MJCF model, so the package uses MujocoDriver (family mujoco) over the card's models[0], hand/body-with-soft/mjcf/left.xml:1. No ROS endpoint, type or command was invented.

WHAT IT SERVES: the left Wuji Hand with soft pad, simulated R0 world.sim. The model has 20 hinge joints (five fingers with four joints each, no free joint) and 20 position actuators, each with an explicit ctrlrange (hand/body-with-soft/mjcf/left.xml:171-190); the model timestep is 0.002 s (hand/body-with-soft/mjcf/left.xml:4). Only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are served. The bridge derives the action.ctrl interval per actuator from actuator_ctrlrange at run time; the package declares no Limit of its own and needs no site-limits.example.json. The other card models (right hand, simplified variants, hand/body left) are not served by this package.

FAKE: MuJoCo was not installed and was not importable where the gate ran, so fake.py is the package's stand-in for the mujoco module, not MuJoCo. It parses the same MJCF for the joint dimensions (20 qpos, 20 qvel), the 20 actuators and their ctrlranges, and integrates placeholder first-order motion toward each control target; it loads no STL mesh, resolves no contact, soft-pad deformation, actuator dynamics, equality, tendon or sensor, and its trajectories are not MuJoCo results. The fake returns the full 20/20/20 arrays. The sim path (a backend that imports the real mujoco module and loads the same file) was not run, so no trajectory or state hash was compared with the real engine. NOT COVERED: the right-hand and simplified variants, rendering, cameras and sensor streams; no physical Wuji Hand is driven.

WARNINGS (none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake is a stand-in library for the simulator family rather than a package class the gate can record; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and the reset seed, the bridge-derived inputs PLAYBOOK.md section 8 calls expected for this family. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings were raised. G8.SAFE014 did not warn because the 20 actuator ctrlranges give the conformance suite bounds to probe.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds seven cases (model shape from the card model, out-of-envelope refusals with zero steps, a step advancing time and joint position, a step without an action, reset to the model defaults, the published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); they pass. check-report.json is regenerated by the gate. The upstream clone was read only and is unmodified.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the MujocoDriver deviation (the clone is a model description package: display.launch.py starts only robot_state_publisher, joint_state_publisher_gui and rviz2, and the card's model hand/body-with-soft/mjcf/left.xml is an MJCF with 20 position actuators that the README loads with mujoco.viewer), the model path and its meshes (present in the clone), the derived shape (20 joints, 20 actuators with explicit ctrlrange, 2 ms), all 14 facts, the stand-in fake and the lockstep latch, which does stop this simulation from advancing. Defects: the stand-in fake, which has no physics, published the real engine's F1 'mujoco:wujihand-left' fidelity contract, which a test asserted; and six facts said more than their lines (two 'so ...' inferences on the compiler and option lines, 'hinge' and 'rad' not on lines 39 and 160, an actuator-section claim from one line, and 'the only ROS2 launch file'). Reviewer changed driver.py (fidelity_by_backend gives the fake its own F0 'analytic:stand-in mujoco module (no physics)' contract, as in the reviewed crl-humanoid-ros and humanoid_control, while the class-level F1 contract keeps the real-engine gaps; six facts narrowed or widened; a fact that the palm body declares no joint), test_driver.py (the fidelity case expects F0 on the fake and F1 on the class) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected MuJoCo-family warnings (G6.NOT_RECORDED, G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND, G8.NO_UNIT x3) and the digest unchanged; the eight package cases pass. For the human reviewer: Simulation only: a MuJoCo model of the left Wuji Hand with soft pad whose palm has no joint, so the hand is fixed to the world; no hardware path exists in the clone and no physical Wuji Hand is driven. The real MuJoCo backend was never run (the STL meshes are in the clone); the fake is a placeholder first-order stand-in. The model path is a relative path into the read-only clone.
